verdict.rationale: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a hardware processor/APU, not a data application or SaaS product that holds a user's data and surfaces insights within its own UI. While the docs describe enabling technologies (ONNX runtime, LLM SDKs, GAIA agent framework) that other software can build on, the chip itself has no 'product' surface with user data to analyze — this axis is a category mismatch for a silicon component.
